headline: Proposal to assign additional CPI control targets to localities from 2027
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Van Thang agreed with the Ministry of Finance's proposal to study extra CPI control targets for localities from 2027. The aim is consistency with socio-economic development directives.
why: Inflation targets set the policy framework that guides Vietnam's monetary and fiscal settings, which matter to investors exposed to the Vietnamese economy and dong-denominated assets.
